description: Universal role ontology + default placement shared by every genre (adaptation_research.md C3). A genre profile `extends` this and supplies only its lexicon (keyword_rules), genre-specific roles, front matter, and any placement overrides. This file is NOT used directly — it is the parent in a layering chain (contracts.resolve_profile).
//front_matter_strategy: preserve = keep the template's pre-heading front matter (cover/title placeholder) — correct when the content has none of its own (e.g. a thesis chapter). replace = wipe it because the content supplies its own title/author/abstract block (e.g. a self-contained paper), so it isn't duplicated. Default preserve = parity.
//note: These 9 roles + their role_to_logical entries are IDENTICAL across vn-thesis and springer-paper, so they live here once. Overlays add genre-specific roles via role_vocabulary (union) + role_to_logical/role_overrides.

role_descriptions.literature_review: Tổng quan, cơ sở lý thuyết, related work, nghiên cứu trước.
role_descriptions.methodology: Phương pháp, cách tiếp cận, thiết kế, mô hình, training.
role_descriptions.results: Kết quả, thực nghiệm, số liệu, đánh giá.
role_descriptions.discussion: Bàn luận, phân tích, diễn giải kết quả.
role_descriptions.conclusion: Kết luận và kiến nghị / future work.
role_descriptions.generic: Nội dung thường, không thuộc vai trò đặc thù nào.

//keyword_rules: Empty in the base — lexicons are language/genre-specific and live in overlays (which REPLACE this list).
//role_to_logical: The universal placement for the 9 shared roles. Values are byte-identical to what the old flat profiles carried, so resolving an overlay reproduces the previous behaviour exactly.
